positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionDecision
positions.frame: what does the decision to adopt Zypherion consist of — the choice itself, the technical justification behind it, and the timing of its execution?
positions.why: Quinton's three statements arrive back-to-back as a single announcement: the adoption choice (src-1), the performance rationale that motivates it (src-2), and the migration timing that follows from it (src-3). Read separately each is a bare declarative or assertive fact; read together they cohere as one decision narrative — what was decided, why, and when it takes effect. No tension between the members; they build on each other in sequence.
